examples.text: De partij moet ophouden haar macht onder te waarderen.
De manager was van oordeel dat de kapitaalmarkt zijn vennootschap onderwaardeerde.

glosses: To underestimate, or assign too low a value to (something or someone); to have too little regard for.

examples.text: I write not this with the leaſt intention to undervalue the other parts of Poetry: for Comedy is both excellently inſtructive, and extreamly pleaſant: […]
[…] I undervalu'd all the Enſigns of Authority which belong'd to me, all the Pomp and Splendor of Life which^([sic – meaning with]) which I was ſurrounded.

glosses: An undervaluation; a price or rate below the actual worth.

examples.text: […] he must therefore prove that the contract was not at such an undervalue as would amount to fraud […]
